metadata.title: MP Climate Intelligence - village-level climate hazard indices
metadata.spatial_unit: village centroid, nearest IMD 0.05 deg pixel (~5.5 km)
metadata.historical_source: IMD 0.05 deg gridded daily Tmax/Tmin/Precipitation NetCDF, 2000-2024
metadata.indices: IMD heatwave definition; SPI (McKee et al. 1993); ETCCDI extreme precipitation
metadata.data_quality: verified - derived from observed IMD gridded data only; no synthetic records
known_limitations: 25-year record is shorter than the WMO 30-year climate normal
village values are nearest-pixel samples, not polygon zonal means
single-station-free gridded product; local microclimate not resolved

cmip6_projection.title: CMIP6 NEX-GDDP physically-based 2040 projection (real, computed 2026-09-01)
cmip6_projection.source: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 (bias-corrected, ~25km downscaled), via Google Earth Engine
cmip6_projection.method: scripts/05b_run_cmip6_2040.py -- Python port of scripts/05_gee_cmip6_2040.js run directly via the Earth Engine Python API (service-account credentials already provisioned for the national climate pipeline), reduced to 5km district buffers, converted via scripts/06_convert_gee_export.py
cmip6_projection.coverage: the same 5 MP districts as the rest of this file (bhopal, indore, jabalpur, rewa, sidhi)
cmip6_projection.note: This replaces the earlier deterministic OLS trend (forecast_2040.json, still labelled INDICATIVE) with an actual physically-based climate-model scenario for these 5 districts, per docs/METHODOLOGY.md section 5.
cmip6_projection.superseded_note: SUPERSEDED 2026-09-02. Computed by scripts/05b_run_cmip6_2040.py over a 5 km buffer around this district's centroid POINT. The authoritative CMIP6 2040 projection for this district is now dashboard/data/cmip6_2040/<state>/<district>.json (scripts/09_gee_national_cmip6_2040.py), which reduces over the district's real Survey of India POLYGON - the same spatial unit every other district-level layer in this portal uses, and the same unit used for all 733 districts. Identical 8-model NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 ensemble, scenario and windows; only the spatial unit differs, and the two agree closely (hot days within 0.5-3.6 d/yr, peak Tmax within 0.3 degC). Retained here for provenance, no longer rendered anywhere. Two further caveats apply to the values in this block: 'heatwave_days_per_yr' is a count of days with Tmax >= 40 degC (a HOT-DAY count), NOT the IMD heatwave-event index used by this file's own observed 'indices' block; and 'max_summer_tmax' / 'rx1day_mm' here are single window maxima, so their deltas carry the window-length bias described in docs/METHODOLOGY.md section 5.

metadata.source: IMD 0.05 deg gridded daily Tmax/Tmin/Precipitation NetCDF, 2000-2024 (India Meteorological Department).
metadata.resolution: ~5.5 km (0.05 deg) IMD grid, sampled per village centroid and rolled up to district; see docs/METHODOLOGY.md Sec 3 and 3.1.
